text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc said Tuesday it began a previously announced cash tender offer for all of the outstanding common shares of Nellcor Puritan Bennett Inc at $28.50 a share in cash.
The tender offer is scheduled to expire at midnight eastern daylight time on Monday, August 25, unless extended.
Mallinckrodt also said it will file today a premerger and report form with the Federal Trade Commission and the antitrust division of the Department of Justice under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act.

Mallinckrodt produces diagnostic imaging agents, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, catalysts, and laboratory and microelectronic chemicals. Nellcor provides products that monitor diagnose and treat respiratory conditions.
The combined companies will have revenues of about $2.4 billion.
